verdict.rationale: Ollama is an LLM inference runtime, so paged KV-cache memory management is a fair axis to judge it on. Nothing in the evidence pack documents paged attention or KV-cache paging. The closest items are adjacent claims: concurrency ("Run multiple models concurrently", "Dedicated capacity") and a community remark that native MLX should improve memory handling. Neither establishes the capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation
